slices.title: ZDR attestation lifecycle and gate alignment
slices.summary: Adds an in-force check to ZDR attestations so an attestation past its review date refuses ZDR with a typed NotInForce result instead of aborting inference-core boot; a lapse never grants ZDR. Also adds a review-by metric, a zdr-attestation-check script, release-gate validation of the Azure and Anthropic fields, alerts for review due and lapsed, and drops the known-gap wording in ZDR.md. No proto or migration change.
test_commands: cd 'apps/Model Plane/rust' && cargo test -q -p inference-core --all-targets (new tests: lapsed_attestation_refuses_zdr_but_boots, review_by_passes_while_running_stops_granting)

slices.title: File size ratchet
slices.summary: Adds a repo-root ratchet that caps hand-written source files at 3,000 lines using per-file ceilings in a committed baseline that may only shrink, compares against the base ref so a PR cannot relax it, and adds an optional, off-by-default clippy count ratchet to the Model Plane Rust CI.

slices.title: Stale-chunk recovery with one reload and notice
slices.summary: Adds installChunkRecovery on vite:preloadError (production builds): one automatic reload inside a 30 s window tracked in sessionStorage, a StaleBuildNotice on the second failure, and no reload while a registered guard reports a dirty composer (text, streaming or pending attachments). Installed in index.tsx before render, with a Playwright project chunk-recovery.

slices.title: Per-tool allow/ask/never, user and org scope
slices.summary: Adds user- and org-scoped per-tool allow, ask and never policies in capability-core. Tightening applies to every row; relaxing to allow applies only to relaxable, digest-pinned mcp_tool rows; org writes need an admin scope; all writes append audit rows and are refused under ZDR. Exposed through the model-gateway proxy, the BFF and two action contracts, behind TOOL_POLICY_ENFORCED.
